title: Louisiana's 1st Congressional District election, 2026
description: Louisiana's 1st Congressional District, covering the suburbs of New Orleans from the northern shore of Lake Pontchartrain to the Mississippi River Delta, is holding a general election on November 3, 2026. Incumbent Republican House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, first elected in 2008, is seeking re-election and faces a Republican primary challenge from Randall Arrington, a retired Navy veteran. Democrat Lauren Jewett, a special education teacher, is running as the presumptive Democratic nominee. The 1st District is considered a safe Republican seat, and the race will ultimately be decided after Louisiana's postponed U.S. House primaries, which were moved to the fall cycle following the Supreme Court's decision in Louisiana v. Callais.
polling_note: No public opinion polls found for this race. The seat is rated 'Solid R' / 'Safe R' by major election forecasters including Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball.

candidates.name: Steve Scalise
candidates.summary: Steve Scalise is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Louisiana's 1st Congressional District and the House Majority Leader. First elected to Congress in 2008, he previously served in the Louisiana State Legislature from 1996 to 2008. He is seeking re-election to a tenth term.

candidates.name: Randall Arrington
candidates.summary: Randall Arrington (also known as Randy) is a retired naval aviator and former federal law enforcement official challenging incumbent Steve Scalise in the Republican primary. He flew attack jets (A-7E Corsair II) as a naval aviator and later served as a deputy director at the Department of Homeland Security. Arrington previously ran against Scalise in the 2024 election.

candidates.name: Lauren Jewett
candidates.summary: Lauren Jewett is a Nationally Board Certified special education teacher with over 16 years of experience in Louisiana public and charter schools, and is the presumptive Democratic nominee for Louisiana's 1st Congressional District. She serves on the Louisiana Democratic Party Executive Committee as the First Congressional District Caucus representative and as an elected Democratic State Central Committee Member for District 78A. Her campaign focuses on public education funding, affordable healthcare, and holding Congress accountable to working families.

forecast.rationale: No public polling is available for this race, which limits quantitative certainty. However, the district is described in the race data as a safe Republican seat and is rated Solid/Safe Republican by Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball. Incumbent Steve Scalise is a long-serving officeholder and House Majority Leader, a high-ranking leadership position that reinforces a strong Republican advantage. While Scalise faces a Republican primary challenger (Randall Arrington), the general election in Louisiana's heavily Republican 1st District strongly favors the eventual Republican nominee, with Scalise as the clear likely winner. Given the absence of polling, confidence is set to medium to reflect reliance on structural and qualitative indicators rather than survey data.
